description: Look up an Unichain transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use unichain_receipt, for emitted events unichain_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xefe004f02c8907dc61735fe378eb5d2f3730d66cd8d4f385ef13076ad1eacdce. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: unichain_tx
title: Unichain transaction
